title: Algebraic extensions of perfect fields are perfect
statement: Let $K$ be a perfect field and $L/K$ an algebraic field extension [def-pc-field-extension]. Algebraic means that every element of $L$ is a root of a nonzero polynomial over $K$. A field is perfect if it has characteristic zero, or has characteristic $p>0$ and every element has a $p$th root. Then $L$ is perfect.
